title: Dusk's Things

body:
Dusk's Things

A collection of random things I've made, all bundled into one mod.

About

This mod bundles a bunch of random things I've made into one singular mod. You can find a list of all features this mod adds below.

Features

Ghost Entities

This feature adds the capability to become a ghost (currently only through an operator command), making it so you're only visible at the edge of a player's vision. You are always able to see yourself, however. On top of players, you can also make entities ghosts, shown above in the demo where a pig has been turned into a ghost!

Spectral Lens

There is an item called the Spectral Lens, which allows you to see both ghosts and invisible entities when worn in the Charm slot (if you have Curios), or when held in your inventory (if you have no accessory mods). You can craft the Spectral Lens with 2 Diamonds, 4 Glass Panes of any kind, 2 Nether Quartz, and 1 Soul Lantern arranged in the pattern below:

Spectral Apple

The Spectral Apple is a consumable food item that provides no nutritional value, but gives the Spectral Transformation status effect upon consumption. Once Spectral Transformation ends, you become a ghost. You can obtain a Spectral Apple by throwing a normal Apple into Soul Fire.
